set.body: Goal: document the already-decided Geom.Line contract. Current implementation preserves encounter and row order within each group and does not sort by x; PlotCompilerSuite already pins that behavior. Remaining acceptance: state in the graphics README that Geom.Line has path semantics, contrast it with ggplot2 geom_line sorting, and note that any future sorted-line geom must be a distinct typed API. Run the focused JVM and Scala.js graphics tests, then close. No compiler implementation is required.
set.title: Graphics docs: state Geom.Line row-order path semantics
